name: IsoSurface Ray Marching
aliases: Pseudo IsoSurface Rendering using Ray Casting
Shader Type 3: Iso Surface with RAY CASTING Method
definition: A ray marching technique that renders an isosurface by detecting zero crossings of the volume scalar field between consecutive samples, refining the hit position via bisection, and shading with Phong lighting. It avoids explicit polygon extraction.
summary: IsoSurface Ray Marching renders isosurfaces by sampling volume fields during ray traversal, distinguishing itself by integrating fixed-step marching directly into the loop rather than using binary search.
